failure_summary.description: Calls omitted part of a full tool name or selected an endpoint that did not match the requested operation or its available inputs.
Calls used incorrect or incomplete parameter values, fields, or requested scope facets.
A requested result or constraint was missing, including game reviews/ratings and some search filters.
A call object repeated the optional-parameters key, risking loss of the parameters in one of the arrays.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already addresses endpoint selection, schema binding, canonical values, and coverage, so repeating those rules is unlikely to help. The trajectories reveal one specific serialization gap: duplicate JSON keys can make parameter arrays ambiguous or cause entries to be discarded. Explicitly prohibit duplicate keys.

edits.target: - Return a parseable JSON list inside the required tags, with exactly the required keys (`tool name`, `required parameters`, and `optional parameters`) in each call object. Include no commentary or reasoning inside the JSON list.
edits.content: - Use each required JSON object key exactly once. Put all parameter entries for a call into its single corresponding required- or optional-parameters array; never repeat a key such as `optional parameters`, since duplicate-key parsing can discard entries.
